purpose: Draft prospective confirmation of the final five-session TSLA design after the v8 RQ2-RQ4 choices are externally locked.

retrospective_evidence.classification: Retrospective chronological development evidence; held out within each run but repeatedly observed across project versions.

locked_design.target: 1[mean(Close[t+1:t+5]) > mean(Close[t-4:t])] using information available through Close[t]
locked_design.execution: Signal after Close[t], execute at Open[t+1], and exit each five-session sleeve at Open[t+6]

primary_metrics: Timing Value versus constant-exposure passive reference (percentage points)
amendment_policy: Any material change to features, model, threshold, target, costs, seeds or stopping rule requires a new protocol ID and a new future window. UI-only changes must be logged.
owner_action_required: Obtain supervisor acknowledgement or another externally verifiable timestamp before the first prospective signal. Until then, status must remain draft and no confirmatory claim may be made.
